<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ITSolutionRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RequestingDepartment" name="Employee or requesting department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Rollout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TrainingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssessRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Install</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_TestUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Support</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestSubmitted" name="IT solution request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess request for compatibility, cost, and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Procure</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Procure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TestUnsuccessful" name="Testing unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Rollout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Skipped</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Continue after training choice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Skipped</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Support" name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Completed" name="Solution rolled out; IT support available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Assess" sourceRef="Start_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Approval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Procure" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Rollout" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="End_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_Training" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provided" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Join" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Skipped" name="No training" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_Support"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_Support" targetRef="End_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
